V-ENCLOSURE.evidence: Lounge deck is enclosed by dense planting on three sides and a wall on the fourth; entry paving is bounded by walls and planting.

V-FOCAL.evidence: No specimen tree, water feature, fire pit, or pergola is present. The plan shows only generic canopy trees, shrubs, and paving without a distinct central feature.

V-AXIS.evidence: Entry paving leads directly to house doors (red diamonds); lounge deck is a destination room; no stray paths.

V-RHYTHM.evidence: Multiple large canopy trees and shrubs are grouped in dense clusters on the left and top, with repeated rows of ground cover along the edges.

V-LAYERING.evidence: Plan shows canopy trees (dark green), small trees (medium green), shrubs (light green), and ground/perennials (pale green) overlapping across the entire garden area.

V-ROOMS.evidence: Lounge deck (grid pattern) with seating and table; entry paving (dotted pattern) leading to house doors; distinct floor surfaces and uses.

V-OVERALL.evidence: Clear spatial structure with defined rooms (lounge deck, entry paving), strong planting masses forming edges, and distinct zones separated by hardscape.
